newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RUGBY UNION-IRELAND MAKE FOUR CHANGES AGAINST SCOTLAND.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-IRELAND MAKE FOUR CHANGES AGAINST SCOTLAND.

text.p: Ireland on Sunday made four changes, three enforced, in their team to face Scotland in next Saturday's Five Nations championship match following their heavy defeat by England.
Scrum-half Niall Hogan was replaced by Brian O'Meara, who was brought on as substitute for Hogan late in the game against England eight days ago.
Fly-half Eric Elwood has not recovered from a knee ligament problem and David Humphreys, who replaced him against England, keeps his place for the clash against the Scots at Murrayfield.
Jonathan Bell switches from centre to left wing in place of James Topping, who has suffered concussion. Kurt McQuilkin takes Bell's place in the centre.
Number eight Eric Miller, who -- like Topping -- is recovering from concussion, yields his place to Ben Cronin, whose only previous cap was two years ago against Scotland.
Team: J Staples, D Hickie, M Field, K McQuilkin, J Bell, D Humphreys, B O'Meara, B Cronin, D McBride, D Corkery, J Davidson, P Johns, P Wallace, R Nesdale, N Popplewell.
Replacements: C O'Shea, P Burke, S McIvor, G Fulcher, G Walsh, A Clarke.
